page.content:
Brazil's 2002 final hat-trick-adjacent redemption after 1998.

How Ronaldo connects

  • Event: 2002 FIFA World Cup — Ronaldo led Brazil to the 2002 World Cup title.
  • Faction: Brazil national team — Ronaldo led Brazil to the 2002 World Cup title.
  • Event: 1998 FIFA World Cup — Ronaldo started the 1998 final after a pre-match collapse.

What is Ronaldo?

Ronaldo Nazário was a spectator-body in the 1998 final, then the eight-goal top scorer who led Brazil to the 2002 title in Japan and South Korea.

Key threads lead to 2002 FIFA World Cup, Brazil national team and 1998 FIFA World Cup.
